text:
Maya: POC alert — OceanicBank import started, customers seeing 429s and partial failures in the data pipeline. Demo in 45m. Can presales / infra triage?
Rob: Oncall SRE/SE pinged. Can we get logs + which routes? Token budget errors sometimes look like 429 but different message.
Anita: They hit /v1/embeddings bulk -> many small batches and /v1/chat/completions for interactive tests. Traffic peaked ~220rps, token churn high because embeddings batch size=1024 and chat sampling set to high temperature.
Anita: Tail log snippet from sandbox (sanitized):
```
2024-07-02T09:12:05Z WARN request_id=bbf11 status=429 tenant=oceanicbank route=/embeddings reason=token_budget_exhausted
x-redwood-token-budget: tenant_total=500k tokens/day used=498732
x-redwood-rate-limit: route=embeddings limit=25rps burst=50 window=60s
2024-07-02T09:12:07Z WARN request_id=bbf12 status=429 tenant=oceanicbank route=/chat/completions reason=per_route_quota_exceeded
x-redwood-rate-limit: route=chat limit=35rps burst=70 window=60s
```
Priya: Looks like both a tenant daily token budget near-saturation and per-route reservations being hit. Presales only requested chat reservation earlier; token budget wasn't increased for their data import.
Maya: Did presales/finops sign off on a token uplift for this POC?
Rob: No uplift logged. Presales form had "interactive demo" checkbox, not "bulk import". Customer assumed token pool would auto-scale.
Anita: Immediate mitigation options: (1) apply temporary token budget top-up for tenant, (2) increase per-route sustain/burst for embeddings and chat, (3) ask client to reduce embed batch size to 256 and pause chat load.
Priya: I can issue an emergency token top-up via admin CLI: 
```
redwoodctl billing token-override --tenant oceanicbank --tokens 250000 --until 2024-07-02T23:59:00Z --reason "presales bulk import emergency"
redwoodctl capacity assign --tenant oceanicbank --route embeddings --sustain 80 --burst 160 --until 2024-07-02T12:00:00Z --reason "presales bulk import emergency"
```
Priya: Note: token override will be charged to the trial credit or billing account. Confirm before applying.
Maya: Go ahead with token top-up + per-route bump. I'll ask them to pause import for 5m and reduce client concurrency to 10 workers.
DeployBot: Token override scheduled: tenant=oceanicbank amount=250000 until=2024-07-02T23:59:00Z by Priya. Capacity bump queued for 2024-07-02T09:13:30Z.
Anita: Also enable tracing header so we can correlate heavy calls: add header `X-Redwood-Trace: <uuid>` and request they send `X-Client-Worker-Id`. That helps map which worker is generating bursts.
Rob: Quick sanity check: how many tokens per embed call are we seeing? Anita, any sample token-accounting?
Anita: From token-accounting logs (sample):
```
request_id=bbf10 route=/embeddings tokens_in=0 tokens_out=2048 model=text-embed-002
request_id=bbf11 route=/chat/completions tokens_in=40 tokens_out=900 model=gptnm-8k
```
Anita: So some embed calls are returning 2k tokens — that's due to input size. Reducing batch size will cut that drastically.
Priya: Override applied. Monitoring now.
Maya: I'll ask SE to change client batch -> 256 and pause for 60s while we verify.
DeployBot: Capacity bump applied at 2024-07-02T09:13:32Z: embeddings +55 sustain, chat +45 sustain for tenant=oceanicbank. Token override active.
Rob: Success rate improving. 429s dropped but I still see occasional 429s from a specific worker id=worker-7.
Anita: It might have been retry storm. Rob, can you pull per-worker traces for the last 10 minutes?
Rob: Pulled the traces. worker-7 retried immediately on backoff=0.5s then hammered when tokens were nearly exhausted; caused localized bursts. I messaged the customer to restart that worker.
Maya: Customer restarted worker-7 and confirmed backpressure is gone. Demo owner reports flows green. :tada:
Priya: Action items: (1) Priya 1 — record token override + billing note in the POC ticket, (2) Maya 1 — update presales intake to include "bulk import / embeddings" as explicit checkbox and require token estimate, (3) Anita 1 — add quick troubleshooting snippet to runbook for token_budget_exhausted errors, (4) Rob 1 1 follow up with customer on optimized batch sizes and offer trial reserved plan.
Maya: I'll also add a short postmortem entry in the account notes and flag for potential Dedicated capacity discussion.
Rob: Closing the swarm. Nice quick turnaround.
Maya: Great work everyone. Leaving override until EOD per customer's ask; we'll revert unless they request extension.
Priya: Revert reminder set for 2024-07-02T23:58:00Z.
DeployBot: Reminder created: revert-token-override tenant=oceanicbank at 2024-07-02T23:58:00Z.
Maya: Demo completed successfully. Customer feedback: appreciated the fast help and clarity on token billing.
Anita: Filed follow-up ticket to propose a small reserved plan for ETL workloads.
Maya: Okay closing thread. :white_check_mark:
